generic_domain.justification: The term 'optimization' is the broadest and most encompassing because all other domains listed are specific instances or subsets of optimization problems. For example, neural architecture search falls under optimization as it seeks to find the best model structure. Similarly, hyperparameter tuning is about optimizing model parameters for better performance. Other domains like loss functions and regularization techniques are all methods aimed at improving (optimizing) the training process and model outcomes. Therefore, 'optimization' serves as the overarching domain that includes all these specific areas.
